keyring.description: Path to keyring file (maps to --keyring); defaults to trustedkeys.kbx/gpg in $GNUPGHOME if empty

ignore_time_conflict.description: Treat timestamp conflicts as warnings (maps to --ignore-time-conflict)

status_fd.description: File descriptor number for status output (maps to --status-fd)

weak_digests.description: List of algorithm names (e.g., MD5, SHA1) to reject signatures using (maps to --weak-digest ALGO...). Each item must be a string matching documented algorithm names.

crypto_policy_file.description: Absolute path to override default crypto policy file (maps to SEQUOIA_CRYPTO_POLICY env var); default is /etc/crypto-policies/back-ends/sequoia.config

gnupghome.description: Absolute path to override $GNUPGHOME (maps to GNUPGHOME env var); default is $HOME/.gnupg
